name: IVIM Technology
summary: IVIMTechnology Co., Ltd. specializes in pioneering solutions for the concurrent imaging of cells and bio-drugs within the diverse tissues and organs of living organisms. Its product line includes models like IVM-C3, IVM-M3, IVM-CM3, and IVM-MS3. The company was established on June 23, 2017, by co-founders Kim Pil-Han and Kim In-Sun, and is based in Daejeon, South Korea.
